project.title: Activated sludge and anaerobic digester prokaryotic community
project.description: Activated sludge and anaerobic digester sludge were sampled at kangbyun  sewage treatment plant. Prokaryotic communities were analyzed using miseq sequencing.
project.center_name: Environmental Microbiology  Microbiology, Pusan National University
